subject: Draw this scene: one huge lake beast rising out of a dark forest lake. Its long thick neck curves up out of the water and its broad heavy-jawed head is turned toward the viewer, with small pale eyes and a row of blunt ridges down the back of the neck; the top of its broad humped back shows above the water behind the neck. Wet dark green-grey scaly hide with a paler grey-green throat, water streaming off it and rings spreading on the lake around it. Dark conifers on the far shore, a grey overcast sky. The beast fills most of the height of the frame. One creature only.
